spec.text:
**airport** has 10 properties. Three would help a flight-ops team:

1. `iata` — the three-letter code, split out of `code`
2. `icao` — required; 11 airports have none
3. a text index on `name`, for *contains* filters

The query I would run:

```cypher
MATCH (a:airport) WHERE a.icao IS NULL RETURN count(a)
```

Two models are stitched:

| From | To | On |
|---|---|---|
| Twitter.Hashtag | AirRoutes.airport | tag ≡ code |
| NewsArticles.Place | AirRoutes.airport | name = city |

- Each is crossable in Explore
- See [the stitch docs](https://example.org/stitches) for how a join is checked

> Nothing changes until you accept a step.

Hashtag.tag matches `airport.code` in any case: **214 of 2,000** sampled tags.

- `#dub` ≡ `DUB`
- `airport.name` matches none
